stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Tote und Verletzte nach Luftschlag auf Vorort von Kiew +++ Selenski meldet 2200 russische Drohnenangriffe in einer Woche

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Deaths and injuries after air strike on Kiev suburb +++ Zelenskyy reports 2200 Russian drone attacks in one week
en.summary: Russia continues its war against Ukraine with recent developments including casualties from an air strike near Kiev and a reported 2200 drone attacks by Russian forces over a seven-day period.

stories.title: En Serbie, le président Aleksandar Vučić démissionne pour tenter de devenir premier ministre

en.title: In Serbia, President Aleksandar Vučić resigns to attempt to become prime minister
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić announced his resignation and will run for prime minister in October elections called after extensive protests and a train station canopy collapse.

stories.title: WM-Strassenrennen der Männer – McNulty nach wildem Rennen überraschend Weltmeister

en.title: Men's World Championship road race – McNulty surprisingly becomes world champion after wild race
en.summary: American cyclist Brandon McNulty won the men's road race world championship title after a 32-kilometer solo breakaway, while Swiss competitor Mauro Schmid finished eleventh.

stories.title: Erstes amerikanisches WM-Gold seit Lance Armstrong: Brandon McNulty gewinnt überraschend das Strassenrennen in Montreal

en.title: First American World Championship gold since Lance Armstrong: Brandon McNulty wins road race in Montreal
en.summary: American cyclist Brandon McNulty won the men's road race at the 2026 UCI Road World Championships in Montreal, marking the first American gold in this event since Lance Armstrong, with Swiss rider Mauro Schmid placing eleventh.

stories.title: Le président serbe Aleksandar Vucic démissionne et brigue le poste de Premier ministre

en.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns and Runs for Prime Minister
en.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation and will seek the position of Prime Minister in legislative elections scheduled for October, which follow nearly two years of student-led protests.

stories.title: Terrorverdacht in England – Anschlag auf britischen US-Stützpunkt geplant: 5 Männer verhaftet

en.title: Terror suspect in England – Attack on British US military base planned: 5 men arrested
en.summary: Police arrested five men on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack on a British US military base.

stories.title: Cinq hommes suspectés de préparer «un acte terroriste» arrêtés près d’une base militaire anglaise

en.title: Five Men Suspected of Preparing "Terrorist Act" Arrested Near English Military Base
en.summary: British police arrested five men suspected of preparing a terrorist act near RAF Fairford in western England after reports of suspicious vans heading toward the airbase used by the U.S. Air Force.

stories.title: En disant oui à la contraception gratuite, Genève devient un laboratoire politique

en.title: Geneva Becomes Political Laboratory by Approving Free Contraception
en.summary: Geneva voters approved a left-wing initiative with 58% support to provide free contraception through public funding without age or income restrictions, with implementation details to be determined by 2028.

stories.title: La qualité de la formation ne sera pas inscrite dans la Constitution bernoise

en.title: Quality of Education Will Not Be Inscribed in Bern's Constitution
en.summary: Nearly 60% of Bernese voters rejected an initiative that would have required the canton and municipalities to provide financial means and human resources to guarantee quality education throughout the region.

stories.title: Vorfall an Militärbasis in England: Fünf Männer stehen unter Terrorverdacht

en.title: Incident at Military Base in England: Five Men Suspected of Terrorism
en.summary: Five men are under investigation on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack at a British air force base used by the U.S. Air Force.

stories.title: Cinq hommes arrêtés pour préparation d'un "acte terroriste" près d'une base aérienne en Angleterre

en.title: Five men arrested for preparation of a "terrorist act" near an air base in England
en.summary: British counterterrorism police are investigating a major incident near a military base in western England used by the U.S. Air Force, where five men have been arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.

stories.title: Busunglück in Deutschland – Reisebus nach München umgekippt – zwei Tote und viele Verletzte

en.title: Bus accident in Germany – Tour bus overturns near Munich – two dead and many injured
en.summary: A tour bus overturned on a highway west of Munich in Germany, resulting in two deaths and numerous injuries.

stories.title: On gewinnt die internationalen Investoren für sich, vergrault aber die Schweizer Politiker

en.title: On wins over international investors but alienates Swiss politicians
en.summary: The Zurich sports brand experiences volatile fortunes as its premium strategy attracts investors, yet the Swiss cross symbol it depends on faces renewed political pressure.

stories.title: Die Schweizer Bildungslücke schrumpft – doch aus dem falschen Grund

en.title: Switzerland's education gap shrinks – but for the wrong reasons
en.summary: According to Pisa studies, educational outcomes between privileged and disadvantaged students are converging, though this apparent progress toward equal opportunity masks underlying concerns.

stories.title: «Dieses Mal ist es anders»: Warum der Anlagechef von Lombard Odier bei KI keine Blase sieht

en.title: "This time is different": Why Lombard Odier's investment chief sees no AI bubble
en.summary: Michael Strobaek argues that major technology companies' substantial AI investments are justified, despite preferring other stocks for his portfolio.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Der arbeitslose Swissair-Pilot von Rio 25 Jahre nach dem Grounding: «Es war eine leichte Befehlsverweigerung, was wir gemacht haben»

en.title: INTERVIEW - The unemployed Swissair pilot from Rio 25 years after the grounding: "It was a slight act of insubordination, what we did"
en.summary: A former Swissair co-pilot who became unemployed when the airline collapsed in 2001 now flies for Swiss and describes differences between the two airlines, particularly that Swiss is operated by a German carrier.

stories.title: Ausgewanderter Schweizer Landwirt: «Ich habe alle meine Ersparnisse nach Argentinien geholt»

en.title: Swiss Farmer Who Emigrated: "I Brought All My Savings to Argentina"
en.summary: Two Swiss farmers transferred their savings to Argentina and supported President Javier Milei's reform course from early on. After two and a half years, they remain convinced of his libertarian policies.
